Real image sourced 2026-09-17 directly from the project's own live download server (dl.nop.hu/rtr-x86_64.qcow2, freeRouter/26.9.16-cur - free/open-source, no vendor account needed) and imported into the Library the normal way. Live-boot ATTEMPTED through netplex's real platform (rule #58) and genuinely blocked, but NOT by netplex: the image is a GraalVM native-image build that hard-requires a CPU with AVX2/BMI2/FMA/F16C (its own boot log names the exact missing features) - VM 702's own underlying physical/virtual CPU only exposes AVX (confirmed via /proc/cpuinfo on the host), a real hardware limit of this specific test machine, not a netplex bug (host-passthrough CPU mode was confirmed correctly wired in the live domain XML). Worth retrying on a host with a newer CPU. NOT live-boot-verified yet for this reason. Wave 38.12/NPX-1167.
